news.title: Mysuru civic body to take action against property tax defaulters
news.para: Mysuru City Corporation officials are strongly urging property owners to settle their overdue tax liabilities promptly. There are clear directives for officials to take action against property tax defaulters in all wards. Legal procedures, such as issuing notices and possibly seizing assets, will ensure tax compliance. Zonal officials are required to complete the notice delivery by the end of September.

news.title: Noida authority fixes uniform rate of ₹86,000 per sq metre for IT/ITeS plots
news.para: Noida Authority has unified IT/ITeS land allotment rates to Rs 86,000 per square metre. This new uniform rate replaces the previous phase-wise pricing system across the city. The decision addresses the shrinking availability of land for fresh large-scale allotments. Noida has become a preferred IT/ITeS destination due to improved regional connectivity. This pricing change aligns with broader upward revisions in land costs around Noida.

news.title: About 150 unsafe buildings in Ghaziabad, but no plan to redevelop them
news.para: Ghaziabad is grappling with an increasing number of hazardous buildings, now totaling more than 150 classified as unfit for occupancy. The Urban Redevelopment Policy 2026 has not yielded significant changes on the ground since its rollout. Residents in Tulsi Niketan express frustration over years of inaction regarding home repairs. While GDA officials claim progress in redevelopment, many perilous structures continue to be overlooked.

news.title: Assam cabinet approves framework for levying green cess on sectors using natural resources
news.para: The Assam Cabinet has sanctioned a green cess policy targeting resource-utilizing sectors while also lifting the age restriction for ex-servicemen applying for government positions. Additionally, a talent identification sports event is set to kick off on November 1st, where promising young athletes will be awarded monthly scholarships to foster their training and growth. This initiative is dedicated to enhancing grassroots participation and ensuring systematic athlete development.

news.title: In Gurugram, Brisk Lumbini RWA seeks action over illegal floor
news.para: Concerned residents of Brisk Lumbini are urging for immediate action regarding an alleged unauthorized construction of a 14th floor. The district town planner has confirmed that no such floor is part of the approved building plans, while the builder's conveyance deed inappropriately mentions exclusive terrace rights at both the 13th and 14th floors.

news.title: Pranav Constructions IPO subscribed 5.69 times on first day
news.para: On its debut day, Pranav Constructions' initial public offering experienced a complete subscription, attracting an impressive bid for over 127 million shares. Non-institutional investors demonstrated strong interest, subscribing 10.60 times, while retail investors followed closely with a 5.76 times subscription rate. Previously, the company secured Rs 84.24 crore from anchor investors. This Rs 351-crore IPO is scheduled to close on September 9.

news.title: The poorest in US can't find housing even as low-income units sit empty
news.para: In the United States, numerous affordable housing units remain unoccupied, primarily because their prices exceed the financial means of the lowest-income residents. Development efforts tend to concentrate on higher-income brackets, which leaves the most vulnerable populations without adequate housing. This trend intensifies issues such as homelessness and financial strain. However, cities are now striving to prioritize housing initiatives that cater directly to those most in need.

news.title: Delhi plans new PG safety policy, but attempts at regulation date back to 1993
news.para: For over thirty years, Delhi has been striving to regulate paying-guest accommodations, with various schemes and committees focused on their registration and licensing. Tragically, a series of recent building collapses has intensified the demand for enhanced safety measures. Despite ongoing efforts, enforcing current building and fire safety regulations remains a daunting challenge. In response, the government is working on a fresh policy aimed at conducting comprehensive building safety audits.

news.title: Eye on New Noida, land rates increased by 53%
news.para: In a move to facilitate the New Noida project, the Noida Authority has increased land acquisition compensation rates, offering a 53% rise for farmers opting for developed plots. This strategy aims to encourage cooperation from landowners during the acquisition process. The ambitious New Noida project is set to become a modern smart city and industrial hub, with land acquisition planned in four phases until the year 2041.

news.title: UK house prices fall 0.4% in August 2026: Lloyds data
news.para: In August, British house prices experienced their first yearly decline in nearly three years, driven by higher borrowing costs that dissuaded potential buyers. Economists predict continued softness in the housing market as uncertainty from global events looms, especially after official data revealed a decrease in annual price growth leading up to June.

news.title: Chandigarh estate office simplifies property services, drops separate NDC requirement
news.para: The Chandigarh estate office has done away with the No Dues Certificate, enhancing the efficiency of property service applications. Now, all government dues verification will occur in a single step, resulting in one demand notice for any outstanding fees. This change not only cuts down on paperwork but also promises to process complete applications within just fifteen working days.

news.title: Are our cities still being planned for a climate that no longer exists?
news.para: Urban planning needs to evolve alongside climate change, leaving outdated historical data behind. Infrastructure built for previous weather patterns may falter against the extreme conditions of the future. Urban areas play a pivotal role in shaping local climates. As India urbanizes swiftly, it is crucial to implement development strategies that withstand future climate projections, ultimately paving the way for resilient urban environments.

news.title: Cabinet nod for Greater Noida West metro likely this month
news.para: The Greater Noida West metro project awaits Union Cabinet approval this month.  This crucial step will enable tendering and construction of the new corridor.  The proposed 8.4km elevated line will connect Noida Sector 51 to Greater Noida West.  Five stations will serve residents, easing current commuting challenges significantly.  The project, costing nearly Rs 2,000 crore, is expected to be completed in four years.

news.title: South Delhi building collapse: MCD seals adjoining building, flags G+4 structure in resettlement colony
news.para: In Satya Niketan, a tragic incident occurred as a five-storey building crumbled, resulting in the deaths of at least three students. Witnesses attribute the disaster to ongoing repair work and excessive water accumulation in the basement. The Municipal Corporation of Delhi has responded by evacuating and securing a neighboring structure. Efforts continue as rescue teams work tirelessly to locate any trapped individuals within the nearly 30-year-old building.

news.title: Delhi: Building was being repaired due to waterlogging in basement, say Satya Niketan residents
news.para: A tragic incident unfolded in Satya Niketan as a five-storey building collapsed, trapping several students inside. Locals pointed fingers at inadequate drainage and rampant construction practices for the catastrophe. Accusations of negligence towards building owners and civic agencies surfaced, highlighting public outrage. As rescue teams work tirelessly, the event raises serious questions about safety standards and maintenance protocols in the vicinity.

news.title: Delhi: Signature view residents seek time-bound redevelopment
news.para: Residents of Signature View Apartments are preparing to approach the Delhi High Court very soon to enforce a previous court order for the demolition and rebuilding of their unsafe flats. Having vacated their homes nearly a year ago, they are now advocating for a definitive timeline for the construction of their residences. This move is aimed at ensuring adherence to court directives and pushing for actual progress in the matter.

news.title: Odisha RERA safety net skips victims of fake property ads on social media
news.para: Akshay Moharana, a software professional, nearly lost one lakh rupees due to a deceitful social media advertisement, while teacher Rajesh Babu fell into the trap and paid an advance for a plot after encountering a similar misleading ad. These incidents highlight a glaring consumer protection failure for investors. Unregistered online sellers reveal that RERA relief is often inaccessible.
